name: Stickley Furniture
old_description: Founded in 2007, The Stickley Museum explores the inspiration and craftsmanship that made Stickley America’s foremost fine furniture maker. An 8,000 square-foot exhibit gallery contains furniture and accessories from the earliest days of Stickley up to the present, as well as a variety of images and archival documents illustrating the company’s journey.
about:
Stickley Furniture operates a retail showroom at 270 Federal Road in Brookfield, Connecticut. The Stickley Museum, founded in 2007, explores the heritage of the Stickley brand, which has been recognized as America’s foremost fine furniture maker. The Brookfield location serves as a physical storefront for the brand, offering a curated selection of furniture and design services.

The showroom sells a range of residential furniture including dressers, beds, tables, desks, bookcases, and the exclusive Fulton Lane collection, as well as Stressless recliners. Services include complimentary design consultations for made-to-order pieces or whole-home projects, white-glove delivery with assembly and placement, warranty support, financing options, and care guides for hardwood, leather, fabric, stone, and hardware. The facility’s size and staff count are not disclosed.

Customers include homeowners, interior designers, and anyone furnishing living rooms, dining rooms, bedrooms, or home offices. The store carries styles from traditional to contemporary, with budget-friendly options alongside premium lines. The showroom also hosts promotional events such as the Multi-Million-Dollar Remodel Event with discounts on Stressless furniture.

Stickley emphasizes its 'Made in America' craftsmanship and the quality and integrity of its workmanship. The Brookfield showroom promotes a no-pressure shopping experience with a well-organized layout and a dedicated Sleep Studio. The company’s differentiators include complimentary design services, white-glove delivery, and a focus on American-made materials such as premium hardwoods, stone tops, and upholstery fabrics.
